INSERT INTO tb_temu_order_product (id, parent_order_sn, seller_id, channel_id, site, children_order_no, ext_code, product_id, product_sku_id, sold_factor, del_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.parentOrderSn}, #{item.sellerId}, #{item.channelId}, #{item.site}, #{item.childrenOrderNo}, #{item.extCode}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productSkuId}, #{item.soldFactor}, #{item.delFlag}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ext_code = VALUES(ext_code), product_id = VALUES(product_id), sold_factor = VALUES(sold_factor), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
